description: Multichain wallet balance: Native balance plus up to 10 ERC-20 balances (symbol, decimals, formatted) for one address on base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia, at the latest block. Source: publicnode JSON-RPC. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: native{symbol, balance}, tokens[]{symbol, decimals, balance}, block.

network.description: one of base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia (default base)

tokens.description: comma-separated ERC-20 contract addresses, up to 10 (optional)

name: x420_chain_balance
